dedupe_keys.name: nsw epa poeo public register of environment protection licences

description: The public register of licensed industrial and other premises in New South Wales. The EPA register page offers searches of environment protection licences, applications, notices, audits and pollution studies and reduction programs, with separate searches of penalty notices, enforceable undertakings, exemptions and prosecutions; a notice says the EPA is moving to a new register and some information is accurate only as at 28 April 2026. The list of licences page offers a free downloadable spreadsheet (XLS, 1.7 MB, updated 19 October 2018) of activities licensed under Schedule 1 of the Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997. Coverage is New South Wales. Caveats: the search results are not a bulk download, the spreadsheet is old, and terms of use apply (their licence is not stated on the page read). For simulation it locates licensed chemical, mining, manufacturing and waste premises and their conditions, for hazard exposure mapping. A related catalogue record is the EPA Risk Management Plan information record.
